mapper.select: select release_time_begin, release_time_end from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_process_task where api_code = #{apiCode} and task_type = 1 and task_status in (0, 1) and is_delete = 0 and release_time_begin is not null and release_time_end is not null order by release_time_begin asc

SELECT task.id AS dprId, customer.cid AS cid, customer.api_code AS apiCode, customer.short_name AS shortName, task.discreet_number AS discreetNumber, task.actual_number AS actualNumber, task.release_time_begin AS releaseTimeBegin, task.release_time_end AS releaseTimeEnd, task.task_type AS taskType, task.task_execute_time AS taskExecuteTime, task.task_status AS taskStatus, task.create_time AS createTime, task.update_time AS updateTime FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_process_task AS task JOIN b_marketing_customer AS customer ON task.api_code = customer.api_code WHERE is_delete = 0 AND ( (task.task_type = 1
AND task.release_time_begin >= #{releaseTimeBegin,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND task.release_time_end <= #{releaseTimeEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
OR task.task_type = 3 ) ORDER BY task.create_time DESC, task.task_execute_time DESC
